---
name: Feature request
about: Propose something oxi should do that it currently doesn't.
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

One or two sentences on what operator pain this solves. Not the solution — the problem.

## Proposed behavior

What you think should happen. Specific, not abstract.

## Alternatives considered

What else would solve the problem? Why is this proposal better?

## Scope

- [ ] Engine core (`oxi-core`)
- [ ] Adapter protocol
- [ ] CLI / dashboard
- [ ] Docs / runbooks
- [ ] CI / packaging
- [ ] Other: ___

## Dogfood candidate?

Can the engine itself ship this via `oxi v3 tick --real-claude`? If yes, add it to `docs/roadmap.md` instead of opening a tracking issue. Issues are for things that need human judgment or cross-concern coordination.
